challenge.title: Two-factor authentication
challenge.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

intro.body: Two-factor authentication protects your trading account by requiring a code from your phone every time you sign in.
intro.bullet1: Use any TOTP-compatible app: Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, Bitwarden.
intro.bullet2: Trades, broker connections, and risk settings are gated behind 2FA.
intro.bullet3: You'll receive 10 single-use backup codes — store them safely.

qr.body: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, OR copy the secret manually.
qr.alt: QR code containing the TOTP enrollment URI

verify.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app to confirm.

backup.body: Save these backup codes somewhere safe. Each one works exactly once and can sign you in if you lose your phone.
backup.warning: These will not be shown again. Store them now.
backup.confirm_saved: I've saved my backup codes in a safe place.

done.body: Two-factor authentication is now enabled on your account.
